t: You're looking at New Scotland Yard on the Victoria Embankment, in Westminster. Since November 2016 it has been the headquarters of the Metropolitan Police, the fourth home the force has had since its foundation in 1829. The building was formerly called the Curtis Green Building, and before that Whitehall Police Station. It was designed by William Curtis Green, an architect and barrister who also designed the Dorchester Hotel and was awarded the Royal Gold Medal in 1942.
